text:
sam: just rolled kernel-autoselect tweak to prefer AVX2-fused kernels for small batches — seeing p99 jump to ~350ms in prod

deploy-bot: deploy finished by sam (sha abc123) :rocket:

maria: noticed it in dashboards, p95 looks fine but p99 is way up. which region/shard?

sam: us-west-2, canary -> gradual -> full. started at 17:02 UTC

alex: quick profile dump, pasted notable numbers:
```
before: p95 78ms  p99 120ms
after:  p95 85ms  p99 350ms
microbatch size dist: 1:62% 2:25% 4+:13%
kvcache hitrate: before 92% after 66%
hot kernel: matmul_fused_smallseq (high setup cost)
```

maria: kv cache hitrate drop is suspicious — did the microbatch heuristic disable prefetch?

sam: we changed target packing to favor filling large kernel lanes; possible we disabled prefix prefetch gate. cc @oncall-julie

oncall-julie: paging in, taking traffic to canary-locked nodes and throttling rollouts. can we toggle back the config while we investigate?

infra-bot: rollback initiated for sam/abc123 -> reverting to sam/abc122, ETA ~2m

oncall-julie: confirm rollback kicked, moving canary -> 20% -> 0%

alex: short perf note: kernel-autoselect chose fused kernel which has nontrivial per-invocation setup. with tiny microbatches and low kvcache hits that setup dominates — slower than the smallseq-optimized kernel.

sam: confirmed, I missed the microbatch edge-case in the selection rule.

maria: customer-facing impact? errors/timeouts?

sam: transient latency spikes caused a few upstream timeouts at ~500ms, no increased error rate in app layer observed. p99 spike lasted ~4m

infra-bot: rollback completed, traffic back to baseline

maria: p99 trending back down to ~125ms :thumbsup:

oncall-julie: will file incident doc. please add repro steps and perf traces in the incident ticket.

alex: root cause summary: selector favored fused kernels based on occupancy estimate; selector ignored kvcache hit-rate and microbatch floor. outcome: high kernel setup cost + low kvcache hits => higher tail latency. Fix proposal: add kvcache_hit_rate threshold and block fused-selection for microbatch <= 2.

sam: opening PR with tests + canary flag now

maria: action items: 1) add unit tests for microbatch distribution boundary cases 2) export per-kernel selection counts to telemetry 3) update rollback playbook for kernel-selector changes

oncall-julie: also update runbook: check kvcache hitrate before any many-node kernel rollout, and include quick-toggle for selector feature flag.

sam: sorry team, good rollback. i learned a lot.

deploy-bot: reminder: create follow-up RFC for kernel selector hardening

alex: +1, and schedule a profiling sweep across short-seq workloads this week

maria: thanks all. will close thread once incident doc linked :pray:

sam: incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian/INCD-345
